thesis: Deterministic fit selects Buffett-style Value as primary and Compounder as secondary. Core score is 80.97, price/Base is 0.502x, TTM owner-style FCF/share is estimated near $21.44, repurchases occurred far below locked Base value, and all Hard Vetoes are cleared. The decisive objection is structural AI substitution: AI-first ARR is material but incrementality and Firefly unit economics remain unknown. Dispersion already narrows the mechanical Core band to 2–4%, and high geopolitical stress sets purchase pacing to 0.5. IC therefore approves NORMAL, not a larger deployment state.

evidence.claim: Aggregate score is 80.97 (Core Outlier); Buffett-style Value is the highest eligible deterministic fit and Compounder is secondary.
Locked price/Base is ~0.502x; Bear/Base/Bull are ~$233.72/$495.57/$817.33 versus $248.92 current price.
RF estimates TTM owner-style FCF after capex and SBC at ~$8.52B, or ~$21.44/share; Q3 diluted shares fell from 424M to 395M y/y.
MA estimates the latest-four-quarter average repurchase price at ~$279.24, ~0.563x locked Base value.
All Hard Vetoes are cleared after refreshed domain and Red Team review; mechanical pre-IC state is CORE_WINNER_CANDIDATE but dispersion narrows position_range_pre_ic to 2-4%.
Macro/geopolitical transmission has no fundamental score effect, but purchase pacing is 0.5 because high conflict/energy/shipping stress is the binding global overlay.

counterevidence: AI-first ARR >$650M proves adoption but not how much spend is incremental versus bundled or reclassified.
Firefly-specific inference cost, gross margin and contribution margin remain undisclosed.
The modeled Bear value is not a liquidation floor; a structural workflow bypass could invalidate the assumed cash-flow floor.
Semrush realized ROIC and post-close standalone economics are not yet observable.
unknowns: AI-first ARR incrementality and Firefly-specific contribution margin.
Same-definition long-run retention/market-share evidence versus prompt-native and agentic workflows.
Realized return on Semrush and capital-allocation discipline through the CEO transition.
falsifiers: Same-definition core ARR/subscription growth turns negative while AI usage rises, indicating substitution without monetization.
Owner-style FCF/share contracts for multiple periods after SBC while AI/R&D spending rises.
A refrozen conservative DCF pushes Bear/current materially below 0.6x or price/Base above 0.85x without stronger evidence.
